provider.label: Provider
provider.description: Which OpenAI-compatible endpoint to talk to. OmniRoute and Ollama are local and need no key.

endpoint.label: Endpoint
endpoint.description: Optional. Overrides the provider's base URL; a pasted .../chat/completions or trailing slash is normalised.

api_key.label: API key
api_key.description: Sent as a Bearer token. An empty key sends no Authorization header at all.

key_source.label: Where the key comes from
key_source.description: Type a key here, or reuse one already stored by OpenCode.

auth_provider.label: Provider name in auth.json
auth_provider.description: Name of the credential inside ~/.local/share/opencode/auth.json. Leave empty when only one is usable.

model.label: Model
model.description: Default model id. The panel's picker overrides it and remembers the choice.

stream.label: Stream responses
stream.description: Show the answer as it arrives. Falls back to a buffered request when streaming is unavailable.

tool_permission.label: Tools
tool_permission.description: Offer run_command, web_fetch and web_search to the model. Off sends no tool definitions at all.

web_search.label: Include web_search
web_search.description: Adds a web_search tool backed by DuckDuckGo's HTML endpoint. Requires tools to be on.

tool_blocklist.label: Blocked command patterns
tool_blocklist.description: Substring patterns that are refused before and after approval, case-insensitive.

max_tokens.label: Max tokens
max_tokens.description: 0 leaves the ceiling to the provider, which is the safer default for reasoning models.

max_history.label: History sent
max_history.description: How many transcript entries are sent to the model on each turn.

system_prompt.label: System prompt
system_prompt.description: Optional instructions prepended to every request.

panel_width.label: Panel width
panel_width.description: Default width for the floating panel in pixels. Close and reopen the panel (or reload Noctalia) for changes to take effect.

panel_height.label: Panel height
panel_height.description: Default height for the floating panel in pixels. Close and reopen the panel (or reload Noctalia) for changes to take effect.

key_store_mode.label: Key storage mode
key_store_mode.description: How API keys are stored: per provider (recommended) or a single global key.

panel.copied_body: The message is on the clipboard.
panel.no_code_body: The last answer has no code block to copy.
panel.code_copied: The last code block is on the clipboard.
panel.no_models: No list yet. Use the refresh button, or type an id and press "Use this text".
panel.more_matches: {count} more results are hidden; narrow the filter.
panel.use_typed_tooltip: Uses the text in the filter as the model id, exactly as written.
panel.blocked: Blocked by the pattern "{pattern}". Edit the blocklist in the settings to allow it.
panel.composer_hint: Enter sends, Shift+Enter adds a line
panel.empty_body: Pick a model above, then write below. Nothing is stored outside this plugin's data directory.

warning.no_endpoint: Set the provider's endpoint in the plugin settings.
warning.no_key: This provider needs an API key; add one in the plugin settings.

error.no_endpoint: No endpoint is configured for this provider.
error.no_key: No API key is available for this provider.
error.no_model: No model is selected yet: open the panel and pick one.
error.busy: A request is already in flight. Stop it first.
error.timeout: The provider stopped sending data; the request was cancelled.
error.bad_json: The provider answered with something that is not JSON.
error.html_body: The endpoint answered with an HTML page instead of a model response. Check the base URL: is it pointing at the right server and at /v1?
error.request_failed: The request could not be started.
error.empty_response: The provider sent an empty response.
error.not_found: The endpoint or model does not exist (404). Check the base URL.
error.rate_limited: The provider is rate limiting this key (429).
error.unreachable: Nothing answered at {endpoint}. Is the local server running?
error.server: The provider failed on its side (HTTP {status}).
error.nothing_to_retry: There is no user message to retry.

notice.length_empty: The answer was cut off by the token ceiling before producing any text. Raise Max tokens or disable the limit.
notice.reasoning_only: The model spent the whole answer on its reasoning trace and returned no text.
notice.tools_disabled: The model asked to use tools, but tools are turned off in the settings.
notice.tool_limit: Stopped after several tool rounds in a row.
notice.stopped_empty: Stopped before the model produced anything.

notify.models_failed: Could not load the model list
notify.stream_ignored: The provider ignored streaming; the request was repeated without it.

test.management_key: This is a management/provisioning key: it authenticates but cannot run inference.

tool.bad_arguments: The model sent arguments that are not valid JSON: {error}
